source_finding.finding: MMI claim_id remained caller-selected and opaque; different proposition text could share one identifier despite evidence-ID and publisher checks.

implementation.algorithm: SHA-256 over namespace plus NFKC-normalized, case-folded, whitespace-collapsed claim text
implementation.punctuation: Preserved; wording differences produce distinct fingerprints
enforcement: Every corroborated/contradictory evidence record must match the canonical fingerprint of its own claim text
MMI adapter generates the fingerprint and rejects caller-supplied mismatches
limitations: A fingerprint binds exact normalized text, not truth or semantic equivalence
Publisher domain identity does not prove independent upstream reporting lineage; origin-source lineage remains separate
